newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Park to swap preferred for common.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Park to swap preferred for common.

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc said Tuesday it had exercised its option to redeem all 2,749,900 of its outstanding depository shares and the related shares of $70 convertible preferred stock in exchange for 0.8333 shares of Hollywood Park common stock per depository share.
The redemption will take place effective August 28, 1997.
The depository shares, which were issued in February 1993, each represent 1/100th of a share of Hollywood Park's $70 convertible preferred stock.

Hollywood Park exercised its option to redeem the depository shares and preferred stock in accordance with the certificate of powers, designations, preferences and rights governing the preferred stock, including the requirement that the trading price of Hollywood Park Common Stock on Nasdaq close above $15 per share on 20 trading days during a 30-consecutive trading- day period. This requirement was met during the period of June 18 to July 28, 1997.
